# JAIPORE Xpress

> JAIPORE Xpress is an Indian restaurant located at 19 Bailey Ave in Ridgefield, CT, operating under the tagline "Taste of India To Go." They offer a diverse menu of traditional Indian dishes, including a wide selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian curries, appetizers, and specialties.
